      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.card_negativePatterns_le {G : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype I] (v : I → G) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ (s : Finset I), (LinearIndependent ℤ fun (i : ↥s) => v ↑i) → s.card ≤ n) :
      (negativePatterns v).card ≤ (n + 1) * (Fintype.card I + 1) ^ n

      For a group with at most n independent elements, the number of strict negative patterns on a finite collection of tests is polynomial.
